NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE VI: LAVASTONES AND THE SCHOOLS OF THOUGHT (LCF-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
Lavastones, the glowing orange-pink stones of Isola's lore, found on beaches and falling from the sky, and what they cost; and the island's schools of thought, Nature, Science, Spiritualism and Magic, arguing with and borrowing from each other.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: A villager wants to use a lavastone to bring out a hidden talent: try it, or train the ordinary way.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has always wanted to sing well, and never could. (subject.He/she) has heard that a lavastone, held while singing, can draw out a talent buried inside you. Some say it brings out what is already there. Some say it puts something there that was not. (friend), the village's best singer, says practice is safer. What should (subject) do?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (subject) holds the stone and sings. (subject.His/her) voice comes out huge and golden, and the whole village stops to listen. Then (subject.he/she) faints. For a week afterwards, (subject.he/she) sings beautifully. Then it fades back to ordinary. (subject) is not sure whether to be grateful or heartbroken.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (friend) teaches (subject) every evening for a season. (subject) improves from terrible to pleasant. It is not golden. It is (subject.his/her) own. At the festival, (subject) sings a short song, and the village claps warmly.
